mainEntity.name: Can I rent out my converted garage apartment in Hillsborough County?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Hillsborough County and nearby Tampa Bay communities, zoning rules dictate whether an apartment conversion can be legally rented to independent tenants or must remain an attached family suite. Local land development codes determine allowable density, lot setbacks, and minimum off-street parking spaces that must remain on the property when a garage stall is eliminated. Some neighborhoods or homeowner associations prohibit standalone rental accessory dwelling units entirely while permitting multi-generational living quarters for relatives. Verifying your property's specific zoning classification before drawing construction plans confirms whether a rental unit is permissible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renting depends on your zoning district, neighborhood rules, and accessory dwelling unit guidelines regarding rental occupancy and required off-street parking stalls.
